items.title: Hackers Exploit Adobe Commerce Zero-Day to Deploy PSK Agent RAT and Remotely Control Servers
items.description:
Attackers are abusing a serious flaw in Adobe Commerce and Magento to install a hidden remote access tool called PSK Agent on online store servers. Once it is running, they can run commands, route traffic through the server, and keep access even after a restart. The flaw, named StyleSmuggler and tracked as CVE-2026-75650, was first […]

items.title: Attackers Started Scanning in the Wild for Linux Kernel RCE Flaw, Ubuntu Releases Fixes
items.description:
Ubuntu has put early kernel fixes for CVE-2026-98432 in its -proposed pocket for 22.04 LTS and newer releases. The bug is a serious Linux kernel flaw that can let a remote user run commands as root without a login or any user action. The patches are still in testing, so many servers stay open for […]
 The post  Attackers Started Scanning in the Wild for Linux Kernel RCE Flaw, Ubuntu Releases Fixes  appeared first on  Cyber Security News .
